# Command line

The `kinemo` command, installed with the package.

Explanatory animations in Python. Every subcommand takes `-h` / `--help`. Exit codes: 0 when everything is fine, non-zero when there are errors (or warnings with `--strict`).

| Command | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`kinemo new`](#new) | create a project |
| [`kinemo dev`](#dev) | browser preview with hot reload and a scrubbable timeline |
| [`kinemo check`](#check) | build + resolve without rendering: errors, lints, timeline |
| [`kinemo inspect`](#inspect) | scene graph at time t |
| [`kinemo snap`](#snap) | PNGs of the requested times |
| [`kinemo voice`](#voice) | make the narration lines that have no audio yet or changed |
| [`kinemo render`](#render) | final output |
| [`kinemo mcp`](#mcp) | MCP server (stdio) with check, inspect, snap, docs and explain |
| [`kinemo docs`](#docs) | short offline docs with a canonical example |
| [`kinemo upgrade`](#upgrade) | codemods between versions |
| [`kinemo doctor`](#doctor) | what kinemo finds on this machine (paste it into bug reports) |
| [`kinemo explain`](#explain) | long explanation of an error or lint |

Scene commands (`dev`, `check`, `inspect`, `snap`, `render`) take the file, `--scene NAME` to pick one scene (default: all) and `--param NAME=VALUE` (repeatable) to set [scene parameters](parameters.md). Settings precedence: CLI > `@k.scene` > `kinemo.toml` > defaults ([configuration](configuration.md)).

<a id="new"></a>
## `kinemo new`

Create a project.

```text
kinemo new [-h] name
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | str |   | (required) |

Examples:

```sh
kinemo new my-video
cd my-video && kinemo check scene.py && kinemo render scene.py
```

<a id="dev"></a>
## `kinemo dev`

Browser preview with hot reload and a scrubbable timeline.

```text
kinemo dev [-h] [--scene SCENE] [--param NAME=VALUE] [--port PORT] [--no-open] [--debug DEBUG] file
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | str |   | (required) |
| `--scene SCENE` | str |   | scene name (default: all) |
| `--param NAME=VALUE` | str |   | (repeatable) |
| `--port PORT` | int | `7878` |   |
| `--no-open` | flag |   | do not open the browser |
| `--debug DEBUG` | str |   | overlays: layout,safe (comma-separated) |

Examples:

```sh
kinemo dev scene.py
kinemo dev scene.py --scene intro --debug layout,safe --port 8000
```

<a id="check"></a>
## `kinemo check`

Build + resolve without rendering: errors, lints, timeline.

```text
kinemo check [-h] [--scene SCENE] [--param NAME=VALUE] [--json] [--strict] [--fix] file
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | str |   | (required) |
| `--scene SCENE` | str |   | scene name (default: all) |
| `--param NAME=VALUE` | str |   | (repeatable) |
| `--json` | flag |   |   |
| `--strict` | flag |   | treat warnings as errors |
| `--fix` | flag |   | apply safe fixes |

Examples:

```sh
kinemo check scene.py
kinemo check scene.py --json --strict
kinemo check scene.py --fix
kinemo check scene.py --scene intro --param n=5
```

<a id="inspect"></a>
## `kinemo inspect`

Scene graph at time t.

```text
kinemo inspect [-h] [--scene SCENE] [--param NAME=VALUE] [--at AT] [--json] [--all] file
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | str |   | (required) |
| `--scene SCENE` | str |   | scene name (default: all) |
| `--param NAME=VALUE` | str |   | (repeatable) |
| `--at AT` | str | `0` | comma-separated: seconds, 'end', a mark, 'mark+1.5', 'mark+50%', or 'marks' (every mark); the scene is built once |
| `--json` | flag |   |   |
| `--all` | flag |   | include objects not in the scene |

Examples:

```sh
kinemo inspect scene.py --at 2.5
kinemo inspect scene.py --at end --json --all
```

<a id="snap"></a>
## `kinemo snap`

PNGs of the requested times.

```text
kinemo snap [-h] [--scene SCENE] [--param NAME=VALUE] [--at AT] [--out OUT] [--sheet] [--columns COLUMNS] [--quality {draft,final}] file
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | str |   | (required) |
| `--scene SCENE` | str |   | scene name (default: all) |
| `--param NAME=VALUE` | str |   | (repeatable) |
| `--at AT` | str | `0,end` | comma-separated: seconds, 'end', a mark, 'mark+1.5', 'mark+50%' (between mark and mark.end), or 'marks' (every mark) |
| `--out OUT` | str | `out` | a folder, or one file (shot.png) for one scene and one instant |
| `--sheet` | flag |   | one labelled contact sheet per scene instead of one PNG per instant |
| `--columns COLUMNS` | int | `3` | columns of the contact sheet |
| `--quality QUALITY` | `draft` \\| `final` | `draft` |   |

Examples:

```sh
kinemo snap scene.py --at 0,2.5,end
kinemo snap scene.py --at intro_done --quality final --out shots
```

<a id="voice"></a>
## `kinemo voice`

Make the narration lines that have no audio yet or changed.

```text
kinemo voice [-h] [--scene SCENE] [--param NAME=VALUE] [--check] [--force FORCE] [--progress {bar,json,none}] file
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | str |   | (required) |
| `--scene SCENE` | str |   | scene name (default: all) |
| `--param NAME=VALUE` | str |   | (repeatable) |
| `--check` | flag |   | list missing and stale lines without making them (exit 1 if any) |
| `--force FORCE` | str |   | script beats to make again, comma-separated (or 'all') |
| `--progress PROGRESS` | `bar` \\| `json` \\| `none` | `bar` | on stderr: a bar, one JSON object per line, or nothing |

Examples:

```sh
kinemo voice scene.py --check
kinemo voice scene.py
kinemo voice scene.py --force B03,B04
```

<a id="render"></a>
## `kinemo render`

Final output.

```text
kinemo render [-h] [--scene SCENE] [--param NAME=VALUE] [--format {mp4,webm,mov,gif,png,svg,slides}] [--quality {draft,final}] [--out OUT] [--at AT] [--frames] [--transparent] [--progress {bar,json,none}] [--subtitles] file
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | str |   | (required) |
| `--scene SCENE` | str |   | scene name (default: all) |
| `--param NAME=VALUE` | str |   | (repeatable) |
| `--format FORMAT` | `mp4` \\| `webm` \\| `mov` \\| `gif` \\| `png` \\| `svg` \\| `slides` |   | default: from the --out extension, else mp4 |
| `--quality QUALITY` | `draft` \\| `final` | `final` |   |
| `--out OUT` | str | `out` | a folder (files named after the scene), or one file: clip.mp4, frame.png |
| `--at AT` | str |   | time (png/svg): seconds, a mark name or 'end' |
| `--frames` | flag |   | png: the whole sequence |
| `--transparent` | flag |   |   |
| `--progress PROGRESS` | `bar` \\| `json` \\| `none` | `bar` | on stderr: a bar, one JSON object per line, or nothing |
| `--subtitles` | flag |   | also write <scene>.srt and <scene>.vtt from the narration |

Examples:

```sh
kinemo render scene.py
kinemo render scene.py --format gif --quality draft
kinemo render scene.py --format png --at end --transparent
kinemo render scene.py --format slides
kinemo render scene.py --subtitles
```

<a id="mcp"></a>
## `kinemo mcp`

MCP server (stdio) with the check, inspect, snap, docs and explain tools, always with --strict.

```text
kinemo mcp [-h]
```

Takes no arguments.

Examples:

```sh
kinemo mcp
```

<a id="docs"></a>
## `kinemo docs`

Short offline docs with a canonical example.

```text
kinemo docs [-h] [--json] [--check] [symbol]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `symbol` | str |   | symbol: k.draw, draw, s.play, Scene.play, ax.plot (optional) |
| `--json` | flag |   | JSON output |
| `--check` | flag |   | build every canonical example (like check --strict) |

Examples:

```sh
kinemo docs
kinemo docs k.morph
kinemo docs s.play --json
kinemo docs --check
```

<a id="upgrade"></a>
## `kinemo upgrade`

Codemods between versions.

```text
kinemo upgrade [-h] [--check] files [files ...]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `files` | str |   | (one or more) |
| `--check` | flag |   | only show the diff; do not write |

Examples:

```sh
kinemo upgrade scene.py --check
kinemo upgrade scenes/*.py
```

<a id="doctor"></a>
## `kinemo doctor`

What kinemo finds on this machine (paste it into bug reports).

```text
kinemo doctor [-h]
```

Takes no arguments.

Examples:

```sh
kinemo doctor
kinemo doctor > setup.txt
```

<a id="explain"></a>
## `kinemo explain`

Long explanation of an error or lint.

```text
kinemo explain [-h] code
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | str |   | (required) |

Examples:

```sh
kinemo explain K0101
```
